I checked the `requirements.md` for the Tasks-tab grid, and it is clear. The title says what it is, and the ask, the files to change and the proof it needs are all listed. I logged one "clear" line in `flags.jsonl`.

`node Server/text-check.mjs` flagged only `past-work.md` in the same folder (901 words of prose, limit 500). That file isn't the target of this check, so I left it alone.

I didn't take screenshots, because the target is an agent brief with no page of its own.
